// The species table and the habitats. Pure data: no engine imports, so `bun test` loads it bare.
//
// Every species has a three-line sprite at most 11 cells wide, drawn in its type's colour. Art is
// original terminal art in the style of the games, not ripped sprites.

export type Kind =
  | 'water' | 'grass' | 'fire' | 'electric' | 'rock' | 'ice' | 'flying'
  | 'bug' | 'ghost' | 'psychic' | 'fighting' | 'normal'
export type Rarity = 'common' | 'uncommon' | 'rare' | 'legendary'

export type Species = {
  name: string
  kind: Kind
  rarity: Rarity
  art: [string, string, string]
  /** the next form and the partner level that reaches it */
  evolves?: { to: string; at: number }
}

export const KIND_COLOR: Record<Kind, string> = {
  water: '#4aa8ff',
  grass: '#5fd35f',
  fire: '#ff6a3d',
  electric: '#ffd83d',
  rock: '#c9a468',
  ice: '#8fe3ff',
  flying: '#b9a7ff',
  bug: '#a3c832',
  ghost: '#9b6bff',
  psychic: '#ff6bc4',
  fighting: '#d9743a',
  normal: '#c8c0b0',
}

export const KIND_ICON: Record<Kind, string> = {
  water: '💧', grass: '🌿', fire: '🔥', electric: '⚡', rock: '🪨', ice: '❄', flying: '🌪',
  bug: '🐛', ghost: '👻', psychic: '🔮', fighting: '👊', normal: '⭐',
}

// Where a prompt leads. Each habitat is a kind and the words that take you there; a prompt scores
// one per word it matches, and the highest habitat wins (earlier wins a tie). No match: normal.
export const HABITATS: ReadonlyArray<{ kind: Kind; words: RegExp; where: string }> = [
  { kind: 'water', where: 'by the water', words: /\b(water|sea|ocean|river|lake|swim|fish|boat|beach|wave|rain|pool|surf|stream|shore|island|dive)\b/i },
  { kind: 'grass', where: 'in the tall grass', words: /\b(land|grass|forest|tree|garden|plant|field|leaf|leaves|park|meadow|jungle|hike|flower|seed|grow)\b/i },
  { kind: 'fire', where: 'near the volcano', words: /\b(fire|hot|burn|flame|lava|heat|volcano|cook|spicy|smoke|torch|ember)\b/i },
  { kind: 'electric', where: 'at the power plant', words: /\b(electric|lightning|power|battery|thunder|volt|charge|energy|spark|storm|current)\b/i },
  { kind: 'rock', where: 'in the cave', words: /\b(rock|stone|mountain|cave|desert|sand|dig|mine|dirt|earth|tunnel|boulder|cliff)\b/i },
  { kind: 'ice', where: 'on the glacier', words: /\b(ice|snow|cold|freeze|frozen|winter|frost|chill|blizzard|glacier)\b/i },
  { kind: 'flying', where: 'up in the sky', words: /\b(sky|fly|bird|wind|cloud|air|plane|wing|feather|soar)\b/i },
  { kind: 'bug', where: 'in the bug-ridden code', words: /\b(bug|bugs|fix|crash|crashes|error|errors|broken|fails?|failing|exception|stack ?trace)\b/i },
  { kind: 'ghost', where: 'in the haunted repo', words: /\b(delete|remove|kill|dead|haunt|ghost|night|dark|legacy|deprecated|zombie|orphan)\b/i },
  { kind: 'psychic', where: 'in deep thought', words: /\b(think|plan|design|architecture|research|brainstorm|idea|ideas|why|explain|strategy|analy[sz]e)\b/i },
  { kind: 'fighting', where: 'at the build gym', words: /\b(build|compile|deploy|docker|ship|release|binary|ci|pipeline|package|bundle|test|tests)\b/i },
]

export const RARITY_WEIGHT: Record<Rarity, number> = { common: 60, uncommon: 28, rare: 10, legendary: 2 }
export const CATCH_RATE: Record<Rarity, number> = { common: 0.65, uncommon: 0.45, rare: 0.28, legendary: 0.1 }
export const RARITY_STARS: Record<Rarity, string> = { common: '★', uncommon: '★★', rare: '★★★', legendary: '★★★★' }

const s = (name: string, kind: Kind, rarity: Rarity, art: [string, string, string], evolves?: { to: string; at: number }): Species =>
  ({ name, kind, rarity, art, evolves })

export const byName = (name: string): Species | undefined => {
  const lower = name.toLowerCase()
  return SPECIES.find(sp => sp.name.toLowerCase() === lower)
}
